tasks.DefineFunction: Write a Python function to shift the last element of a list to the first position.
tasks.TestFunction: Run predefined test cases on the created function.

Questions.content: What will happen if the list is empty? Will the function handle it, or should it raise an error?
What will happen if the list contains only one element? Will the function return the same list or raise an error?
